resources.string: Enter the address you use to open ProxMate in a browser.
This is a ProxMate server, but it reports a problem (its database may be unavailable). Try again shortly.
That address answered, but it isn\'t a ProxMate server. Enter the address you use to open ProxMate in a browser.
That address redirects to %1$s. Check it and tap Continue to use it.

%1$s uses http://, so your password and session will be sent unencrypted. Anyone on the network between you and the server can read them.\n\nOnly continue on a network you fully trust. Using https:// is strongly recommended.
That page would load over an unencrypted connection and was blocked.

This server\'s certificate isn\'t issued by an authority your device trusts (it may be self-signed). The app will trust exactly this certificate for this server, and nothing else, only if you confirm it.

WARNING: this server now presents a different certificate from the one you trusted before. This is expected only if the certificate was replaced on purpose. Otherwise someone may be intercepting the connection: cancel.

Compare the fingerprint with the one on the server (for example: openssl x509 -noout -fingerprint -sha256 -in cert.pem). The safer option is a certificate from a trusted authority, such as Let\'s Encrypt.
The certificate was not trusted. Use a certificate from a trusted authority, or check the fingerprint and try again.
The server\'s certificate isn\'t trusted and couldn\'t be read. Use a certificate from a trusted authority.
The server\'s certificate is no longer the one you trusted. Check it before connecting again.
The server presented a certificate that isn\'t trusted and isn\'t the one you accepted. The connection was stopped. Use Change server to check the certificate again.
The app will no longer accept the self-signed certificates you trusted. You will be asked again the next time you connect.
Unencrypted connection (http://): your password is sent in plain text.
Sign in with SSO or a passkey
Sign in with %1$s or a passkey
Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app, or one of your recovery codes.
Your login session expired. Please sign in again.
The server accepted the sign-in but sent no session. Try again, or use the web sign-in.
Signed in, but the session couldn\'t be kept. If the server uses http://, its session cookies must not be marked Secure (COOKIE_SECURE=false).
Passkeys work in the web sign-in only where the device\'s WebView supports them. If yours doesn\'t, sign in with ProxMate in a browser.
You\'re signed out. Sign in again to continue.
No app can open this link.
No app is available to choose a file.
Sign out and connect to a different server?
